text:
Aisha: Starting thin-slice blue->green handoff in 5m for release v3.1. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: 2% steps for first 10%, then 10% until 60%, pause on p95>250ms or errors>0.4%. Will post updates.
deploy-bot: Kickoff: deploy pipeline initiated (job: release/v3.1/canary). Smoke tests scheduled. Links: https://ci/internal/2026/v3.1
Tiernan: Heads-up: router binary pinned to 2.4.0 for compatibility; disabling cookie rewrites for the window. Confirmed via orchestration.
Aisha: Ops quick-run for weight changes (for on-call):
```
# bump green by 2%
curl -X POST "https://router-admin/svc/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"payments","green":2}'
# sanity check
curl "https://router-admin/svc/status?service=payments" | jq .active
```
deploy-bot: Applied weight update: green=2 -> green=4. Canary VM group warming.
Riley: Observing metrics: p50 stable, p95=120ms at 4% green. No error uptick. Traces normal.
ops-bot: Canary health: all probes passing on green nodes. No 5xx.
Aisha: Continue ramp. Tagging release notes with canary metric snapshot.
deploy-bot: Applied weight update: green=10 (post-warm).
Riley: At 10% green, slight increase in backend latency to connector-y; error-rate 0.12%. Not alarming.
Tiernan: Running distributed tracing sample: noticed occasional HEAD timeouts upstream on green only. Opening a quick debug trace.
Riley: At 20% green, p95 climbs to 260ms and errors 0.45% (just under threshold). Suggest hold and investigate.
Aisha: Hold at 20%. Lock further increases. Team, please check dependency graphs and recent infra changes.
Tiernan: Correlation shows green instances hitting a new internal API with a slightly different header format. Router pin avoided header rewriting but the app expects old header; patch incoming.
Riley: Error-rate nudging to 0.6% on a small subset of routes. Ops recommends rollback unless patch can be hotfixed within 10m.
Aisha: Decision: roll back to blue to be safe. Execute rollback procedure.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback: setting green=0 -> blue=100. Rolling back canary servers.
ReleaseBot: Rollback completed. Canary job stopped. Incident created INC-8124. Please add timeline to postmortem.
Riley: Post-rollback metrics: p95 down to 130ms, errors back to baseline 0.05%.
Tiernan: Patch for header compatibility drafted, running unit + staging smoke. Will request a narrow retry window once validated.
Aisha: Thanks all. Add note to changelog: "v3.1 canary paused and rolled back due to header mismatch causing connector-y latency; router pin preserved client headers; follow-up patch planned." :thumbsup:
